notes.title: Kromaticube Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Kromaticube is now compatible with Android and is available on the PlayStore.
[*]Obstacles are now triggered by FPS instead of music that could avoid jam obstacles with slow configuration.
[*]Some obstacles design from level 5 has been modified for more consistency.
[*]Backspace on the keyboard is now used as a previous button.
[/list]
